quote: At Home, the crunch subject is the Colony. Citizens contribute in equal, individually apportioned shares; good stewardship creates a stable home that can run well, make room for ambition, and permit ordinary life to be experienced.
claim: At Home, the Colony is the crunch subject; Citizens contribute equal, individually apportioned shares, and good stewardship creates a stable home that can run well, make room for ambition, and permit ordinary life to be experienced.

quote: RTS production grid | Colony posture | Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories. Places support Practices; Citizens occupy Roles; the colony succeeds as a whole.
claim: The Home Loop replaces the RTS production-grid model with colony posture, where buildings support Practices, Citizens occupy Roles, and the colony succeeds as a whole rather than as individual factories.

quote: Worker optimization | Equal civic shares | Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home. Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.
claim: The reworked model replaces worker optimization with equal civic shares: each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home, while personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode rather than domestic productivity ranking.

quote: Continuous entropy | Achievable equilibrium | Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load. The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.
claim: The reworked model replaces continuous entropy with achievable equilibrium: adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load, allowing the colony to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.

quote: Local repair clicking | Global condition | Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.
claim: The reworked model replaces local repair clicking with global condition: diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.

quote: Passive debuffs | Latent vulnerability | Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure. They do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.
claim: The reworked model replaces passive debuffs with latent vulnerability: Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure without automatically inflicting daily punishment in every affected category.

quote: Generic random events | Weakness-shaped MEET | A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure. The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.
claim: The reworked model replaces generic random events with weakness-shaped MEET: a hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure, and the two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.

quote: Five-button event board | Three-choice transaction | A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.
claim: The reworked model replaces the five-button event board with a three-choice transaction: a Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.

quote: Flavor text as reward | Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY | Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space. EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.
claim: The reworked model replaces flavor text as reward with Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY: competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space, and EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.

quote: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL). It replaces the familiar base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
claim: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL), replacing the base-builder model of production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.

quote: The player is not asked to maximize a factory. The player is asked to establish a home that is materially sound, seasonally prepared, socially coherent, and capable of continuing ordinary life while selected Citizens travel into danger.
claim: The player's task is not to maximize a factory but to establish a home that is materially sound, seasonally prepared, socially coherent, and able to sustain ordinary life while selected Citizens travel into danger.

quote: The desired success state is not perpetual acceleration. It is a functioning colony with enough margin to remain stable, pursue chosen ambitions, and permit the player to notice the Citizens who inhabit it.
claim: The desired success state is not perpetual acceleration but a functioning colony with enough margin to remain stable, pursue chosen ambitions, and let the player notice the Citizens who inhabit it.

quote: The player's task is not to prevent perpetual collapse. It is to establish and periodically restore the conditions under which ordinary life can occur.
claim: The player's task is not to prevent perpetual collapse but to establish and periodically restore the conditions under which ordinary life can occur.

quote: Create a mechanically credible domestic life whose success can be understood and achieved.
claim: The Home system aims to create a mechanically credible domestic life whose success can be understood and achieved.

quote: Make low population meaningful: every assigned headcount is a visible civic commitment and an Away opportunity cost.
claim: The system makes low population meaningful by treating every assigned headcount as a visible civic commitment and an Away opportunity cost.

quote: Express species identity through settlement topology rather than through decorative building skins or generic bonuses.
claim: The system expresses species identity through settlement topology rather than through decorative building skins or generic bonuses.

quote: Allow routine competence to suppress crises without requiring constant player attention.
claim: Routine competence suppresses crises without requiring constant player attention.

quote: Convert abstract shortfalls into specific, memorable situations through the Encounter Register (MEET).
claim: Abstract shortfalls are converted into specific, memorable situations through the Encounter Register (MEET).

quote: Provide Quiet Equilibrium as the enabling condition for EMBODY, Campaign Memory, voluntary Projects, and emotional linger time.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium is the enabling condition for EMBODY, Campaign Memory, voluntary Projects, and emotional linger time.

quote: Citizens hold Roles. Roles sustain Practices. Practices inhabit Places. Places create Load according to species spatial logic. Capacity meeting Load produces Readiness; unresolved deficiency becomes vulnerability; MEET turns vulnerability into a situated choice.
claim: Citizens hold Roles, Roles sustain Practices, Practices inhabit Places, Places create Load according to species spatial logic, Capacity meeting Load produces Readiness, unresolved deficiency becomes vulnerability, and MEET turns vulnerability into a situated choice.

quote: MEDIAN uses different scales of mechanical attention in Home and Away play. This is not a difference between anonymous and named Citizens. It is a difference in the subject being resolved.
claim: MEDIAN uses different scales of mechanical attention in Home versus Away play, reflecting a difference in the subject being resolved rather than between anonymous and named Citizens.

quote: Crunch subject | The Colony | The individual Citizen or expedition party
claim: At Home the crunch subject is the Colony; Away, it is the individual Citizen or expedition party.

quote: Primary question | How much civic capacity is committed to each responsibility? | Which particular Citizen can survive, solve, carry, notice, or endure this situation?
claim: At Home the primary question is how much civic capacity is committed to each responsibility; Away, it is which particular Citizen can survive, solve, carry, notice, or endure the situation.

quote: Citizen unit | One equal, individually apportioned Role share | Personal abilities, gear, conditions, history, and exposure
claim: At Home a Citizen unit is one equal, individually apportioned Role share; Away, it is personal abilities, gear, conditions, history, and exposure.

quote: Growth target | Places, Practices, reserves, margins, population, and colony tier | Citizen capability, equipment, wounds, distinctions, relationships, and experience
claim: At Home the growth target is Places, Practices, reserves, margins, population, and colony tier; Away, it is Citizen capability, equipment, wounds, distinctions, relationships, and experience.

quote: Primary risk | A weakened colony posture caused by absence, expansion, season, or shortfall | Hazard, injury, Exposure, Tharn, loss, or individual reward
claim: At Home the primary risk is a weakened colony posture caused by absence, expansion, season, or shortfall; Away, it is hazard, injury, Exposure, Tharn, loss, or individual reward.

quote: Success affect | Stability, confidence, and room to inhabit | Return, survival, discovery, and transformed Citizens
claim: At Home success affect is stability, confidence, and room to inhabit; Away, it is return, survival, discovery, and transformed Citizens.

quote: At Home, a Citizen is an individually accounted-for unit of commitment. Away, a Citizen is an individually resolved unit of capability.
claim: At Home a Citizen is an individually accounted-for unit of commitment; Away, a Citizen is an individually resolved unit of capability.

quote: Colony | DWELL | Home | Maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.
claim: The Colony register (DWELL), primarily available at Home, maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.

quote: Field | TRAVEL | Away | Carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.
claim: The Field register (TRAVEL), primarily available Away, carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.

quote: Crossing | RISK | Away | Resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.
claim: The Crossing register (RISK), primarily available Away, resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.

quote: Encounter | MEET | Home and Away | Stages any bounded consequential situation: storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute.
claim: The Encounter register (MEET), available at Home and Away, stages any bounded consequential situation such as storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute.

quote: Embodiment | EMBODY | Home only | Makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.
claim: The Embodiment register (EMBODY), available only at Home, makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.

quote: DWELL establishes order -\> Citizens leave -\> AWAY creates exposure -\> Citizens return -\> DWELL restores equilibrium -\> EMBODY makes safety felt
claim: The Home Loop cycles: DWELL establishes order, Citizens leave, Away creates exposure, Citizens return, DWELL restores equilibrium, and EMBODY makes safety felt.

quote: The colony is the Home crunch subject.** Domestic calculations operate globally. Individual names remain attached to assignments, absence, advice, memory, and availability without becoming productivity multipliers.
claim: The colony is the Home crunch subject; domestic calculations operate globally, and individual names remain attached to assignments, absence, advice, memory, and availability without becoming productivity multipliers.

quote: A stable colony can actually be stable.** Adequate Capacity fully covers routine Load. The system does not manufacture daily chores merely to preserve engagement.
claim: A stable colony can actually be stable: adequate Capacity fully covers routine Load, and the system does not manufacture daily chores merely to preserve engagement.

quote: Competence creates quiet.** The reward for sound stewardship is a broad plateau of safety in which Projects, observation, EMBODY, and ordinary Citizen life can occur.
claim: Sound stewardship rewards the player with a broad plateau of safety in which Projects, observation, EMBODY, and ordinary Citizen life can occur.

quote: Global abstraction is a strength.** Diffuse structural wear, care work, storage attention, and watchfulness are colony postures. They need not be simulated as hundreds of tiny local tasks.
claim: Diffuse structural wear, care work, storage attention, and watchfulness are colony postures that need not be simulated as hundreds of tiny local tasks.

quote: Important consequences become local.** When an abstract vulnerability matters enough to become a story, MEET places it in a specific zone, Place, household, route, or relationship.
claim: When an abstract vulnerability matters enough to become a story, MEET places it in a specific zone, Place, household, route, or relationship.

quote: Shortfall is vulnerability, not automatic punishment.** Insufficient coverage raises the likelihood and stakes of a fitting Colony Encounter instead of applying a constant stack of unrelated debuffs.
claim: Insufficient coverage raises the likelihood and stakes of a fitting Colony Encounter instead of applying a constant stack of unrelated debuffs.

quote: Spatial identity is mechanical identity.** JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT alter Load, resilience, failure geometry, and lived experience.
claim: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT alter Load, resilience, failure geometry, and lived experience.

quote: Home survives; Away enables advancement.** Local ecology and ordinary Practices support continued life. Exceptional materials, knowledge, access, and growth arrive through Expeditions.
claim: Local ecology and ordinary Practices support continued life at Home, while exceptional materials, knowledge, access, and growth arrive through Expeditions.

quote: Player attention is a protected resource.** The interface should settle at Dawn, explain what changed, and then grant permission to linger without real-time deterioration.
claim: The interface should settle at Dawn, explain what changed, and then grant permission to linger without real-time deterioration.

quote: Good Home play produces successful stillness.
claim: Good Home play produces successful stillness.

quote: Citizen | A named member of the colony who contributes one equal Home share, occupies a current Role, may travel Away, and carries individual history. | A variable-output worker token or permanent profession.
claim: A Citizen is a named member of the colony who contributes one equal Home share, occupies a current Role, may travel Away, and carries individual history — not a variable-output worker token or permanent profession.

quote: Role, may travel Away, and carries individual history. | A variable-output worker token or permanent profession. | | Role | A share of current civic responsibility: Builder, Caretaker, Watchkeeper, and so forth. | A character class, aptitude score, or lifelong career.
claim: A Role is a share of current civic responsibility such as Builder, Caretaker, or Watchkeeper — not a character class, aptitude score, or lifelong career.

quote: Practice | The repeated communal activity sustained by a Role: upkeep, cultivation, warning, teaching, care, fabrication. | A hidden production recipe detached from daily life.
claim: A Practice is the repeated communal activity sustained by a Role — upkeep, cultivation, warning, teaching, care, fabrication — not a hidden production recipe detached from daily life.

quote: Place | The built or claimed environment in which a Practice becomes materially possible and socially legible. | A stand-alone factory whose primary purpose is output per minute.
claim: A Place is the built or claimed environment in which a Practice becomes materially possible and socially legible — not a stand-alone factory whose primary purpose is output per minute.

quote: Project | A deliberate, time-bounded undertaking measured in Citizen-Days: construction, expansion, repair, preparation, or memorial work. | An endless passive queue that must remain full.
claim: A Project is a deliberate, time-bounded undertaking measured in Citizen-Days — construction, expansion, repair, preparation, or memorial work — not an endless passive queue that must remain full.

quote: Condition | A global colony state such as Structural Condition, Stores, Cohesion, or seasonal preparedness. | A separate health bar on every wall, ladder, pantry, and burrow.
claim: A Condition is a global colony state such as Structural Condition, Stores, Cohesion, or seasonal preparedness — not a separate health bar on every wall, ladder, pantry, and burrow.

quote: Role assignment is fluid and colony-scaled. Reassigning a Citizen changes the colony's posture; it is not a respec operation.
claim: Role assignment is fluid and colony-scaled; reassigning a Citizen changes the colony's posture rather than functioning as a respec operation.

quote: A Citizen assigned as a Builder contributes one Builder Capacity regardless of personality, Away statistics, or prior assignment.
claim: A Citizen assigned as a Builder contributes one Builder Capacity regardless of personality, Away statistics, or prior assignment.

quote: The player sees exactly which Citizens make up the total, preserving individual apportionment without turning Home into a personnel-ranking puzzle.
claim: The player sees exactly which Citizens make up the Role total, preserving individual apportionment without turning Home into a personnel-ranking puzzle.

quote: Home gives Citizens history. Away gives Citizens progression.
claim: Home gives Citizens history; Away gives Citizens progression.

quote: A Role normally sustains an ongoing Practice. Positive margin may be redirected into a Project.
claim: A Role normally sustains an ongoing Practice, and positive margin may be redirected into a Project.

quote: For example, Builder Capacity first covers the colony's routine Building Load; any remaining margin can accelerate a construction Project or prepare for forecast pressure.
claim: Builder Capacity first covers the colony's routine Building Load, with any remaining margin able to accelerate a construction Project or prepare for forecast pressure.

quote: The system does not describe ordinary life as Citizens being "idle" when no queue is active.
claim: The system does not describe ordinary life as Citizens being idle when no queue is active.

quote: Species identity is embedded directly into land use.
claim: Species identity is embedded directly into land use.

quote: A well-designed settlement should remain identifiable when uninhabited.
claim: A well-designed settlement should remain identifiable by species even when uninhabited.

quote: Placement alignment is represented primarily by how layout changes relevant Load, route resilience, warning, care, and failure propagation - not by a generic universal percentage pasted onto every system.
claim: Placement alignment is represented primarily by how layout changes relevant Load, route resilience, warning, care, and failure propagation, not by a generic universal percentage pasted onto every system.

quote: Mouse | JOIN | Manor House | New Places belong to one protected inhabited system through shared walls, foundations, doorways, enclosed passages, or short covered links. | Continuity reduces enclosure and circulation Load, but a poorly joined failure can propagate through adjacent rooms.
claim: Mouse settlements follow JOIN, forming the Manor House image where new Places belong to one protected inhabited system through shared walls, foundations, doorways, or covered links; continuity reduces enclosure and circulation Load, but a poorly joined failure can propagate through adjacent rooms.

quote: Rabbit | GATHER | Court / Cul-de-Sac | Burrows and Places orient toward shared negative space: green, hearth, meeting court, or working yard. | Coherent courts reduce Care and Coordination Load; oversized or fragmented courts lose mutual visibility and neighbor-scale intimacy.
claim: Rabbit settlements follow GATHER, forming Court/Cul-de-Sac images where Burrows and Places orient toward shared negative space; coherent courts reduce Care and Coordination Load, but oversized or fragmented courts lose mutual visibility and neighbor-scale intimacy.

quote: Squirrel | CONNECT | Web | Separated nodes are linked by credible routes. Redundancy, not proximity alone, turns an outpost into colony space. | Alternate routes reduce Watch, provisioning, and isolation Load; one-route branches remain brittle.
claim: Squirrel settlements follow CONNECT, forming a Web image where separated nodes are linked by credible, redundant routes; alternate routes reduce Watch, provisioning, and isolation Load, but one-route branches remain brittle.

quote: Leadership | Central chamber, long table, or protected inner room. | Council green, elder burrow, or court-facing meeting place. | High junction or network node visible from several routes.
claim: Leadership space translates as a central chamber or long table (Mouse), a council green or elder burrow (Rabbit), or a high junction/network node visible from several routes (Squirrel).

quote: Care | Deep, sheltered sickroom connected to family rooms. | Quiet infirmary burrow near but not inside court bustle. | Recovery drey reachable by two safe routes.
claim: Care space translates as a deep sheltered sickroom connected to family rooms (Mouse), a quiet infirmary burrow near but not inside court bustle (Rabbit), or a recovery drey reachable by two safe routes (Squirrel).

quote: Craft | Attached workshop within the protected body. | Workshop facing a shared working yard. | Work platform placed along supply and cache routes.
claim: Craft space translates as an attached workshop within the protected body (Mouse), a workshop facing a shared working yard (Rabbit), or a work platform placed along supply and cache routes (Squirrel).

quote: Storage | Deep pantry rooms within the Manor. | Household stores plus a communal reserve near the court. | Distributed caches with deliberate redundancy.
claim: Storage translates as deep pantry rooms within the Manor (Mouse), household stores plus a communal reserve near the court (Rabbit), or distributed caches with deliberate redundancy (Squirrel).

quote: Teaching | Warm interior gathering room and accumulated objects. | Circle on the common green or in a court-side chamber. | Teaching perch or route junction where several branches meet.
claim: Teaching space translates as a warm interior gathering room with accumulated objects (Mouse), a circle on the common green or a court-side chamber (Rabbit), or a teaching perch/route junction where several branches meet (Squirrel).

quote: Mouse builds rooms. Rabbit builds neighbors. Squirrel builds connections.
claim: Mouse builds rooms, Rabbit builds neighbors, Squirrel builds connections.

quote: A colony-scale Structural Condition is not a retreat into abstraction; it is the correct resolution for Home Mode. It compresses softened earth, loosened lashings, damp insulation, shifted stones, blocked drainage, ordinary patching, and hundreds of small acts of upkeep into one legible posture.
claim: A colony-scale Structural Condition is the correct Home Mode resolution, compressing many small acts of upkeep and decay into one legible posture.

quote: The statistic is global because maintenance is a colony posture, not a set of individual repair orders.
claim: Structural Condition is a single global statistic because maintenance is treated as a colony posture rather than individual repair orders.

quote: Structural Condition | Buildings, burrows, route anchors, coverings, drainage, retaining earth, access paths. | Builder coverage, layout, Projects, weather, and Encounter outcomes. | MEET names the threatened room, court edge, route, roofline, or node.
claim: Structural Condition compresses buildings, burrows, route anchors, coverings, drainage, retaining earth, and access paths, changes via builder coverage, layout, Projects, weather, and Encounter outcomes, and surfaces in fiction as MEET naming the threatened room, court edge, route, roofline, or node.

quote: Stores | Food protection, placement, spoilage, reserve accessibility, material organization. | Caretaking, preservation, season, consumption, relocation, and loss. | MEET names the pantry, cache, hanging stores, household reserve, or supply route.
claim: Stores compresses food protection, placement, spoilage, reserve accessibility, and material organization, changes via caretaking, preservation, season, consumption, relocation, and loss, and surfaces in fiction as MEET naming the pantry, cache, hanging stores, household reserve, or supply route.

quote: Cohesion / Resolve | Confidence, displacement, perceived fairness, grief, coordination, and willingness to mobilize. | Leadership, Teaching, relationships, repeated sacrifice, success, and failure. | MEET identifies who disagrees, who is frightened, or which households bear the cost.
claim: Cohesion/Resolve compresses confidence, displacement, fairness, grief, coordination, and willingness to mobilize, changes via leadership, teaching, relationships, sacrifice, success and failure, and surfaces in fiction as MEET identifying who disagrees, who is frightened, or which households bear the cost.

quote: Health posture | Current patients, medical readiness, illness exposure, and recovery burden. | Healer Capacity, supplies, injury, season, crowding, and Exposure aftermath. | Specific Citizens become patients; treatment remains individual where dramatically important.
claim: Health posture compresses current patients, medical readiness, illness exposure, and recovery burden, changes via Healer Capacity, supplies, injury, season, crowding, and Exposure aftermath, and surfaces in fiction as specific Citizens becoming patients while treatment stays individual where dramatically important.

quote: If routine Building Capacity meets routine Building Load, Structural Condition does not decline.
claim: If routine Building Capacity meets routine Building Load, Structural Condition does not decline.

quote: Builders are already finding and fixing small problems.
claim: Builders are already finding and fixing small problems, which is why ordinary equilibrium does not require additional decline.

quote: A flood or storm can add exceptional pressure or produce a MEET, but the simulation must not charge the colony a permanent daily maintenance tax merely because time passed.
claim: A flood or storm may add exceptional pressure or produce a MEET, but the simulation must not impose a permanent daily maintenance tax merely because time passed.

quote: Diffuse routine strain | Absorbed through Role coverage and global Conditions. | No clicking; visible only when a meaningful state changes.
claim: Diffuse routine strain is absorbed through Role coverage and global Conditions, with no clicking and visibility only when a meaningful state changes.

quote: Acute but bounded incident | Resolved through MEET and returned to global Conditions. | One consequential choice moment.
claim: An acute but bounded incident is resolved through MEET and returned to global Conditions, presented as one consequential choice moment.

quote: Transformative local loss | A Place may become unusable, displaced, renamed, or converted into a focused Project. | Used sparingly when the Place itself has become story.
claim: A transformative local loss may render a Place unusable, displaced, renamed, or converted into a focused Project, used sparingly when the Place itself has become story.

quote: A single Role shortfall should not simultaneously increase Encounter frequency, worsen every option, inflict automatic daily damage, and create a mandatory repair queue unless the event is deliberately severe enough to justify each layer.
claim: A single Role shortfall should not simultaneously increase Encounter frequency, worsen every option, inflict automatic daily damage, and create a mandatory repair queue, unless the event is deliberately severe enough to justify each layer.

quote: Usually, the Encounter transaction is the charge.
claim: Usually the Encounter transaction itself constitutes the charge for a Role shortfall.

quote: Sustenance is adjudicated at Dawn and exists in two forms to create a seasonal survival rhythm without turning Home into a constant starvation treadmill.
claim: Sustenance is adjudicated at Dawn and exists in two forms to create a seasonal survival rhythm without constant starvation pressure.

quote: Perishable Sustenance | High-yield daily food during green seasons. | Gardeners and suitable managed nodes create expected seasonal yield. | Daily spoilage, washout, heat, poor storage, or expedition absence.
claim: Perishable Sustenance is high-yield daily food during green seasons, generated by Gardeners and managed nodes, at risk from daily spoilage, washout, heat, poor storage, or expedition absence.

quote: Durable Sustenance | Reserve food for winter, travel gaps, and disruption. | Existing perishables are preserved through appropriate Caretaking, Kitchen, herbal, or cultural Practice. | Insufficient preparation, damaged stores, or consumption during prolonged pressure.
claim: Durable Sustenance is winter and travel reserve food, made by preserving perishables through Caretaking, Kitchen, herbal, or cultural Practice, at risk from insufficient preparation, damaged stores, or consumption during prolonged pressure.

quote: Flexible Scrap | General-purpose recovered material used for Projects and emergency responses. | Primarily brought home from Away; may be sorted or converted by Crafters. | Overspending on convenience leaves no emergency reserve.
claim: Flexible Scrap is general-purpose recovered material for Projects and emergency responses, mainly brought home from Away and sorted or converted by Crafters, with risk of overspending leaving no emergency reserve.

quote: Supply Items | Bounded expedition consumables: rope, torch, flare, patch, marker, prepared kit. | Crafters transform specific recovered materials and known Practices. | Cannot be generated infinitely from quiet Home time alone.
claim: Supply Items are bounded expedition consumables that Crafters transform from specific recovered materials and known Practices, and cannot be generated infinitely from quiet Home time alone.

quote: Medical Stores | Medicine, dressings, herbs, recovery supplies. | Healers and herbal Practices prepare them from available materials. | Patient load, cold season, injury clusters, or scarce ingredients.
claim: Medical Stores are medicine, dressings, herbs, and recovery supplies prepared by Healers and herbal Practices, at risk from patient load, cold season, injury clusters, or scarce ingredients.

quote: The colony can survive at Home, but it cannot advance there indefinitely.
claim: The colony can survive at Home but cannot advance there indefinitely.

quote: Home provides labor, continuity, transformation, and ordinary subsistence.
claim: Home provides labor, continuity, transformation, and ordinary subsistence.

quote: Away provides exceptional matter, knowledge, access, seeds, tools, and relationships.
claim: Away provides exceptional matter, knowledge, access, seeds, tools, and relationships.

quote: A Crafter with no recovered material does not passively manufacture advanced expedition solutions forever.
claim: A Crafter with no recovered material does not passively manufacture advanced expedition solutions forever.

quote: A successful Home Loop prepares for and interprets Away play; it does not replace it.
claim: A successful Home Loop prepares for and interprets Away play but does not replace it.

quote: Green-season yield -\> Preservation Projects -\> Durable reserve -\> Winter drawdown -\> Shortfall or surplus shapes Spring
claim: The seasonal rhythm flows from green-season yield through preservation Projects to durable reserve, winter drawdown, and a shortfall or surplus that shapes Spring.

quote: A well-run colony should be capable of entering winter with a credible reserve and then coasting through ordinary days.
claim: A well-run colony should be able to enter winter with a credible reserve and then coast through ordinary days.

quote: Seasonal challenge comes from planning, unusual weather, ambition, and expedition choices - not from food numbers being tuned so tightly that every Dawn is triage.
claim: Seasonal challenge should come from planning, unusual weather, ambition, and expedition choices, not from food numbers tuned so tightly that every Dawn is triage.

quote: The Home Loop grows when the player chooses to make the colony more capable, more extensive, or more meaningful. Growth is not forced by exponential consumption. It is an act of ambition that temporarily spends the quiet the colony has earned.
claim: The Home Loop grows through voluntary player ambition rather than forced exponential consumption, temporarily spending the quiet the colony has earned.

quote: Stable posture -\> Available margin -\> Choose a Project -\> Accept temporary thinness -\> Complete new Place / Practice -\> Establish new equilibrium
claim: Growth follows a flow from stable posture through available margin, choosing a Project, accepting temporary thinness, completing a new Place or Practice, and establishing a new equilibrium.

quote: Add a Residence | Population capacity and a new inhabited Place. | More Care, Stores, Watch, and structural Load. | Mouse joins a room; Rabbit completes or buds a court; Squirrel adds and secures a node.
claim: Adding a Residence gains population capacity and a new inhabited Place, obligates more Care, Stores, Watch, and structural Load, and is expressed by species as joining a room, completing or budding a court, or adding and securing a node.

quote: Add a Practice Place | New civic capability or lower existing Load. | A Place must be maintained and socially integrated. | Form changes by JOIN, GATHER, or CONNECT rather than by universal building kit.
claim: Adding a Practice Place gains new civic capability or lowers existing Load, obligates maintenance and social integration, and is expressed by species-specific form changes rather than a universal building kit.

quote: Extend territory | Access, resources, observation, or future founding. | Longer routes, more edges, warning, and supply responsibility. | Squirrel strands, Rabbit daughter courts, Mouse attached wings or protected portals.
claim: Extending territory gains access, resources, observation, or future founding, obligates longer routes, more edges, warning, and supply responsibility, and is expressed by species as strands, daughter courts, attached wings, or protected portals.

quote: Prepare for forecast pressure | Reduced future cost or silent success. | Consumes positive margin and may delay other Projects. | The exact preparation is species- and Place-specific.
claim: Preparing for forecast pressure reduces future cost or enables silent success, consumes positive margin and may delay other Projects, with the exact preparation being species- and Place-specific.

quote: Create a memorial or civic feature | Campaign Memory becomes visible in the colony. | Time and material without direct economic output. | Architecture records the species' way of gathering, joining, or connecting.
claim: Creating a memorial or civic feature makes Campaign Memory visible in the colony, costs time and material without direct economic output, and expresses the species' way of gathering, joining, or connecting through architecture.

quote: Construction Queue is retained as an implementation concept but should be presented to the player as Projects.
claim: Construction Queue is retained as an implementation concept but must be presented to the player as Projects.

quote: A home undertakes "Reinforce the east wall" or "Open the daughter court," not "Building slot 2: 43 percent."
claim: Project presentation reads as a named undertaking such as "Reinforce the east wall" rather than as a numeric build-slot percentage.

quote: Stabilize -> inhabit -> desire something more -> accept disruption -> establish a new stability.
claim: The growth rhythm moves from stabilizing to inhabiting to desiring more, accepting disruption, and establishing a new stability.

quote: Quiet Equilibrium is the broad Home success plateau in which routine obligations are covered, no acute Encounter is unresolved, and the colony is not demanding immediate posture repair.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium is the broad Home success plateau where routine obligations are covered, no acute Encounter is unresolved, and no immediate posture repair is demanded.

quote: It does not require maximum surplus, perfect optimization, or universal positive margins.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium does not require maximum surplus, perfect optimization, or universal positive margins.

quote: Crisis | An active Encounter, acute condition, or immediate failure requires resolution. | MEET, emergency retasking, consequence management.
claim: Crisis means an active Encounter, acute condition, or immediate failure requires resolution, experienced as MEET, emergency retasking, and consequence management.

quote: Strained | One or more meaningful deficiencies exist, but the colony continues to function. | Risk assessment, preparation, limited Projects; EMBODY may be unavailable until acute instability clears.
claim: Strained means one or more meaningful deficiencies exist while the colony still functions, with EMBODY potentially unavailable until acute instability clears.

quote: Quiet Equilibrium | Routine obligations are covered closely enough that no immediate intervention is required. | Globally available EMBODY for any present and available Citizen; observation, planning, and voluntary Projects.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium means routine obligations are covered closely enough that no immediate intervention is required, making EMBODY globally available for any present and available Citizen alongside observation, planning, and voluntary Projects.

quote: Flourishing | Equilibrium plus reserves, positive margins, and available civic attention. | Ambitious Projects, expansion, cultural work, generous preparation, and richer domestic expression.
claim: Flourishing is equilibrium plus reserves, positive margins, and available civic attention, enabling ambitious Projects, expansion, cultural work, generous preparation, and richer domestic expression.

quote: The colony is not being paid for stability. Stability is the condition under which life has time to become visible.
claim: Stability is not itself rewarded; stability is the condition under which life has time to become visible.

quote: EMBODY belongs globally to Home Mode.
claim: EMBODY belongs globally to Home Mode.

quote: Once Quiet Equilibrium and its requisites are maintained, the player may enter the Embodiment Register through any present, available Citizen or suitable inhabited Place.
claim: Once Quiet Equilibrium and its requisites are maintained, the player may enter the Embodiment Register through any present, available Citizen or suitable inhabited Place.

quote: It is not unlocked by that Citizen's individual Role Margin, and it does not clear acute Tharn.
claim: EMBODY access is not unlocked by a Citizen's individual Role Margin and does not clear acute Tharn.

quote: Dwell proves that the colony is safe; EMBODY proves that safety means something.
claim: Dwell proves that the colony is safe, while EMBODY proves that safety means something.

quote: The former Webisode function is folded into EMBODY and Campaign Memory.
claim: The former Webisode function is folded into EMBODY and Campaign Memory.

quote: Character exposure, two-sentence intimacy, domestic humor, shared history, and ordinary grace survive, but sensory and guided experience become the primary delivery mechanism.
claim: Character exposure, two-sentence intimacy, domestic humor, shared history, and ordinary grace survive, but sensory and guided experience become the primary delivery mechanism.

quote: Text initiates, punctuates, or remembers the moment rather than carrying the entire Home reward by itself.
claim: Text initiates, punctuates, or remembers the moment rather than carrying the entire Home reward by itself.

quote: Equal Home contribution does not make Citizens interchangeable as characters.
claim: Equal Home contribution does not make Citizens interchangeable as characters.

quote: It prevents the Home economy from ranking friends by domestic productivity.
claim: Equal contribution prevents the Home economy from ranking friends by domestic productivity.

quote: Identity is expressed through presence, association, history, advice, relationship, and consequence.
claim: Citizen identity is expressed through presence, association, history, advice, relationship, and consequence.

quote: Occupancy | The UI shows which named Citizens constitute each Role total and which Places they inhabit. | Names do not alter Capacity value.
claim: Occupancy shows which named Citizens constitute each Role total and which Places they inhabit, without names altering Capacity value.

quote: Continuity | Long service associates a Citizen with a Place, routine, route, household, or civic responsibility. | Continuity may affect memory and presentation, not hidden productivity.
claim: Continuity associates a Citizen with a Place, routine, route, household, or civic responsibility over long service, affecting memory and presentation but not hidden productivity.

quote: Absence | Taking a named Citizen Away removes exactly one Home share and may change margins. | The cost is legible headcount, not an opaque loss of 1.7 "best worker" units.
claim: Taking a named Citizen Away removes exactly one Home share and may change margins, costing legible headcount rather than an opaque fractional productivity loss.

quote: Advice | A current Role holder may speak in a Home Encounter and interpret the threatened value. | Advice frames the choice; it need not reveal exact hidden odds.
claim: A current Role holder may speak in a Home Encounter and interpret the threatened value, framing the choice without necessarily revealing exact hidden odds.

quote: Condition | Wounds, treatment, Away status, and incapacity affect availability. | Personal states change whether the Citizen can contribute, not how efficient their normal Home share is.
claim: Wounds, treatment, Away status, and incapacity affect a Citizen's availability to contribute, not the efficiency of their normal Home share.

quote: Campaign Memory | Encounters, Projects, Places, and EMBODY moments become shared references, jokes, grief, memorials, and habits. | Memory produces attachment and future content, not automatic economy buffs.
claim: Campaign Memory turns Encounters, Projects, Places, and EMBODY moments into shared references, jokes, grief, memorials, and habits, producing attachment and future content rather than automatic economy buffs.

quote: At Home, Citizens are equal shares of unequal obligations. Away, Citizens are unequal people facing the same danger.
claim: At Home, Citizens are equal shares of unequal obligations; Away, Citizens are unequal people facing the same danger.

quote: A Builder shortage may be presented through Sedge advising the colony to brace ladders first. The calculation remains Builder Capacity; the fiction is inhabited by Sedge. If Sedge leaves on an Expedition, the colony loses one Builder share, another Citizen may occupy the Role, and later Campaign Memory can preserve that Sedge was the one who knew the Upper Reach before the storm.
claim: A Builder shortage may be dramatized through a named Citizen like Sedge advising the colony, with the underlying calculation remaining Builder Capacity, and Campaign Memory later preserving that Citizen's specific role in the event.

quote: The Home UI must expose causes without revealing the director. The player should understand the colony's posture and the consequences of reassignment, while retaining uncertainty about which circumstance will become the next MEET.
claim: The Home UI must expose causes and the consequences of reassignment without revealing the director, preserving uncertainty about the next MEET.

quote: Named Role occupants and total Capacity | Exact per-Role encounter weight | The player can apportion Citizens without solving the director.
claim: The UI shows named Role occupants and total Capacity while hiding exact per-Role encounter weight, so the player can apportion Citizens without solving the director.

quote: Current Role Load and qualitative Margin band | Exact pressure score and next trigger threshold | The player sees thinness but cannot count down to a crisis card.
claim: The UI shows current Role Load and a qualitative Margin band while hiding the exact pressure score and next trigger threshold, so the player sees thinness but cannot count down to a crisis card.

quote: Current Conditions, Projects, resources, season, and forecasts | Big and Small Weakness ranking | The player understands the world state while each colony retains emergent vulnerability.
claim: The UI shows current Conditions, Projects, resources, season, and forecasts while hiding Big and Small Weakness ranking, so the player understands world state while each colony retains emergent vulnerability.

quote: Warnings such as "Structural upkeep is thin" or "Stores are lightly attended" | Tie-breaking, persistence multipliers, category cooldowns | Mystery remains causal rather than arbitrary.
claim: The UI shows plain-language warnings while hiding tie-breaking, persistence multipliers, and category cooldowns, so mystery remains causal rather than arbitrary.

quote: Encounter costs and broad consequence previews | Full random tables and exact downstream probability | Choices are informed without becoming spreadsheet certainty.
claim: The UI shows Encounter costs and broad consequence previews while hiding full random tables and exact downstream probability, keeping choices informed without becoming spreadsheet certainty.

quote: Recommended daily summary: one compact Dawn ledger with meaningful changes, Role bands, Project progress, Sustenance movement, and any new warning.
claim: The recommended daily summary is one compact Dawn ledger showing meaningful changes, Role bands, Project progress, Sustenance movement, and any new warning.

quote: Once read, the interface quiets. Values should not continue degrading in real time while the player inspects a Place or enters EMBODY.
claim: Once read, the Dawn ledger interface quiets, and values must not continue degrading in real time while the player inspects a Place or enters EMBODY.

quote: Structures | SOUND | 2 Builder Capacity covers 2 Building Load. No deterioration.
claim: In the example Dawn ledger, Structures reads SOUND because 2 Builder Capacity covers 2 Building Load, with no deterioration.

quote: Stores | THIN | 1 Caretaker covers 2 Store/Care Load. A deficiency has persisted for one Dawn.
claim: In the example Dawn ledger, Stores reads THIN because 1 Caretaker covers 2 Store/Care Load, a deficiency having persisted for one Dawn.

quote: Watch | READY | 2 Watchkeeper Capacity covers 1 Load, leaving +1 readiness.
claim: In the example Dawn ledger, Watch reads READY because 2 Watchkeeper Capacity covers 1 Load, leaving +1 readiness.

quote: Sustenance | 18 Perishable / 27 Durable | 12 consumed; 3 preserved; 1 spoiled.
claim: In the example Dawn ledger, Sustenance shows 18 Perishable / 27 Durable, with 12 consumed, 3 preserved, and 1 spoiled that day.

quote: Projects | Daughter Court: 4 / 6 Citizen-Days | One Builder share and one Caretaker share committed today.
claim: In the example Dawn ledger, the Daughter Court Project shows 4/6 Citizen-Days, with one Builder share and one Caretaker share committed that day.

quote: Home state | QUIET EQUILIBRIUM AT RISK | No crisis. Care coverage is thin; EMBODY remains available unless the strain becomes acute.
claim: In the example Dawn ledger, Home state shows QUIET EQUILIBRIUM AT RISK, with no crisis but thin Care coverage, and EMBODY remains available unless the strain becomes acute.

quote: The exact threshold at which Strained blocks EMBODY should be a colony-wide rule, not a per-Citizen calculation.
claim: The exact threshold at which Strained blocks EMBODY should be a colony-wide rule, not a per-Citizen calculation.

quote: The key legibility promise is that the UI states why the mode is available or unavailable in plain language.
claim: The key legibility promise is that the UI states in plain language why EMBODY is available or unavailable.

quote: If two Roles share the same deficiency, persistence may break the tie; if still tied, recent manifestation history should favor variety.
claim: When two Roles share the same deficiency, persistence breaks the tie, and if still tied, recent manifestation history favors variety.

quote: If only one relevant weakness exists, the Small Weakness may be the least buffered eligible Role, a current Condition, or an environmental complication rather than an invented unrelated deficiency.
claim: When only one relevant weakness exists, the Small Weakness may be the least buffered eligible Role, a current Condition, or an environmental complication, rather than an invented unrelated deficiency.

quote: Before departure, the player receives a clear delta: "Removing Moss reduces Watch Margin from +1 to 0" or "Taking Sedge creates Building Margin -1 until return."
claim: Before an expedition departs, the player is shown a concrete delta illustrating how the choice changes a Margin, such as reducing Watch Margin or creating a Building Margin deficit.

quote: Nothing must happen while they are away. The player accepted a risk, not a guaranteed tax.
claim: Nothing is guaranteed to happen to the colony from a reduced Role's coverage while the Citizen is away; the player has accepted a risk, not a certain tax.

quote: If a fitting pressure arrives, the Register makes that thinness concrete.
claim: If a fitting pressure arrives during the expedition, the relevant Register turns the accepted thinness into a concrete consequence.

quote: Home Mode resolves the Colony; Away Mode resolves individual Citizens.
claim: Home Mode resolves the Colony, while Away Mode resolves individual Citizens.

quote: Every present Citizen assigned to a Role contributes one equal unit of Home Capacity.
claim: Every present Citizen assigned to a Role contributes one equal unit of Home Capacity.

quote: Roles are current civic responsibilities, not character classes or aptitude tracks.
claim: Roles represent current civic responsibilities rather than character classes or aptitude tracks.

quote: Places support Practices and alter contextual Load; they are not primarily stand-alone production factories.
claim: Places support Practices and alter contextual Load, rather than functioning primarily as stand-alone production factories.

quote: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT determine species spatial alignment, Load, resilience, and failure geometry.
claim: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT determine species spatial alignment, Load, resilience, and failure geometry.

quote: Adequate Capacity can fully cover routine Load. The colony can run well without continuous deterioration.
claim: Adequate Capacity can fully cover routine Load, allowing the colony to run well without continuous deterioration.

quote: Projects use integer Citizen-Days and represent chosen ambition, restoration, preparation, or civic meaning.
claim: Projects use integer Citizen-Days and represent chosen ambition, restoration, preparation, or civic meaning.

quote: Negative Role Margins enter an obscured Deficiency Ledger; not every empty Role is contextually deficient.
claim: Negative Role Margins enter an obscured Deficiency Ledger, though not every empty Role is contextually deficient.

quote: Deficient Role count and deficit depth set the frequency pressure for shortage-driven Colony Encounters.
claim: Deficient Role count and deficit depth set the frequency pressure for shortage-driven Colony Encounters.

quote: The Big and Small relevant Weaknesses determine the primary and collateral manifestation of a Home Encounter.
claim: The Big and Small relevant Weaknesses determine the primary and collateral manifestation of a Home Encounter.

quote: Home MEET normally offers two distinct spends and one refusal with a compounded consequence.
claim: Home MEET normally offers two distinct spends and one refusal carrying a compounded consequence.

quote: Global Conditions absorb diffuse consequences; specific Place Projects are reserved for transformative local outcomes.
claim: Global Conditions absorb diffuse consequences, while specific Place Projects are reserved for transformative local outcomes.

quote: Quiet Equilibrium makes EMBODY globally available at Home for any present and available Citizen.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium makes EMBODY globally available at Home for any present and available Citizen.

quote: Campaign Memory preserves meaningful domestic and Away history without becoming a mandatory buff economy.
claim: Campaign Memory preserves meaningful domestic and Away history without becoming a mandatory buff economy.

quote: An Age of Empires-style production optimization layer with service radii and worker throughput percentages.
claim: The design explicitly excludes an Age-of-Empires-style production optimization layer with service radii and worker throughput percentages.

quote: A full-time fight against arbitrary decay, hunger, or condition leakage.
claim: The design excludes a full-time fight against arbitrary decay, hunger, or condition leakage.

quote: Individual Home aptitude ratings, hidden career multipliers, or "best worker" roster sorting.
claim: The design excludes individual Home aptitude ratings, hidden career multipliers, or 'best worker' roster sorting.

quote: A separate local repair order for every damaged wall, ladder, room, burrow, or route.
claim: The design excludes a separate local repair order for every damaged wall, ladder, room, burrow, or route.

quote: An event screen with many near-duplicate choices or one obviously correct answer.
claim: The design excludes an event screen with many near-duplicate choices or one obviously correct answer.

quote: A simulation in which every Role must be staffed at all times regardless of context.
claim: The design excludes a simulation in which every Role must be staffed at all times regardless of context.

quote: A Home economy that creates unlimited advanced progression without Away materials and discoveries.
claim: The design excludes a Home economy that creates unlimited advanced progression without Away materials and discoveries.

quote: An emotional-content meter that turns friendship, memory, or EMBODY into another optimized currency.
claim: The design excludes an emotional-content meter that turns friendship, memory, or EMBODY into another optimized currency.

quote: The Home Loop succeeds when the colony is mechanically credible, strategically legible, capable of genuine equilibrium, and emotionally spacious enough that the player can care about the small lives the system protects.
claim: The Home Loop succeeds when the colony is mechanically credible, strategically legible, capable of genuine equilibrium, and emotionally spacious enough that the player can care about the small lives the system protects.
